policy.note: This register controls permitted engineering claims and separates demo smoke tests from independent truth. It is not a license interpreter or legal approval.

actualByteVerification.note: Historical byte check only. The image was not retained. Every new download must be independently re-hashed before use.

independence.reason: The published textured GLB comes from the same capture imagery, and the 1.997 m AprilTag bar was used as scan-scaling control. Neither is established as independent held-out building truth.

limitations: One image byte check does not establish a complete multi-view capture.
No independent full-building survey, independent dimensions, vertical datum or held-out checkpoints are established for this sample.
Source license declaration and uploader authority have not been independently authenticated.
